title: Get fast proof of the dashboard frame, navigation and settings

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage

**Caught.** At `957e366440439526a464d3b3110e1cd627ec772f`, slice 2 of `SEED-413#speed-dashboard-frame-and-navigation-proof` protects the selected project when another control has already handled an arrow key. The probe removed only the `event.defaultPrevented` guard from `dashboard/src/projectKeyboardNavigation.ts:103`.

The existing mounted case “help, editing, native controls, prevented events and modifiers keep their arrows” uses a four-project catalog. With Open Dough selected and System settings focused, its capture listener prevented the native Right Arrow. The faulted run reached that key and failed at the first assertion in `keepsOpenDough` in `dashboard/frontend-tests/navigation/project-keyboard-navigation.spec.ts:195`. The Open Dough radio was false. Independently, the failure screenshot showed Doughnut selected and its queued and taken stories rendered while focus remained on System settings. The later route assertion and prevented Left Arrow were beyond the failure. [Fault diff](/tmp/dough-frame-intent-probe.E5uYQs/fault.diff) · [Fault run](/tmp/dough-frame-intent-probe.E5uYQs/fault.log) · [Browser screenshot](/tmp/dough-frame-intent-probe.E5uYQs/fault-browser.png)

The same test command ran on a detached scratch checkout on AC power, with the locked install and a two-worker limit. One case passed before the edit, failed during the probe, and passed after byte-for-byte restoration. Git status matched the initial clean state, and I removed the scratch checkout. [Baseline run](/tmp/dough-frame-intent-probe.E5uYQs/baseline.log) · [Restored run](/tmp/dough-frame-intent-probe.E5uYQs/restored.log)

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/navigation/project-keyboard-navigation.spec.ts --grep 'help, editing, native controls, prevented events and modifiers keep their arrows' --workers=2 --reporter=line
```

**Next proof action** Keep the existing assertion for the observed prevented Right Arrow path. This probe warrants no additional case or stronger assertion.

- **Test runtime** 7.04 seconds total, measured from the Vitest duration lines (2.35 seconds baseline, 2.62 seconds faulted, 2.07 seconds restored).
- **Human effort** Unavailable. Human time was not instrumented for this probe.
- **Agent effort** Unavailable. Active agent time was not measured separately from elapsed time.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 137522 ms (measured), from 1795484918000 to 1795485055522 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.


Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 957e366440439526a464d3b3110e1cd627ec772f, Caught on the observed prevented Right Arrow path, no follow-up.
